_meta.description: Per-client project Data Table manifest for the Supplier Data Collection platform. Aligned to revised schema (post-architecture shift). Consumed by R-2a provisioning recipe.

notes.creation_order: Tables are ordered so that FK targets are created before FK sources. Relation-type columns (Workato UI display helpers) are separated into the 'deferred_relations' array and applied in Pass 2 via PUT after all tables exist.
notes.folder_id: Injected at runtime by the provisioning recipe. Not included in this manifest.
notes.field_ids: Omitted — Workato auto-generates UUIDs on creation. The recipe captures and maps them from the POST response.
notes.string_length: Workato Data Tables API exposes only 'string' as a type. There is no API-level 'long-text' distinction. Fields noted as needing long-text capacity (valid_payload, validation_summary) are flagged in hints. If Workato introduces a long-text API type, update those fields.
notes.relation_fields: Relation-type columns are Workato UI display helpers only. They do NOT enforce referential integrity. All real joins use the business ID string fields (e.g., field_id, supplier_request_id).

tables.name: WFA_TemplateProject
tables.purpose: Root entity for a data collection initiative. One per client project.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-2a at provision time.

schema.name: project_name
schema.hint: Client name. Set once at provision.

schema.name: analyst_email
schema.hint: Analyst who owns this project. May change on rotation.

schema.name: target_vms
schema.hint: VMS identifier for this engagement.

schema.name: correlation_id
schema.hint: FK → home base Requests.correlation_id. Immutable.

tables.name: VER_TemplateVersion
tables.purpose: Immutable snapshot of a template definition. Defines what is valid for a given intake cycle.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-2a.

schema.name: template_project_id
schema.hint: FK → WFA_TemplateProject.id. Immutable.

schema.name: version_number
schema.hint: Monotonic version counter. Immutable.

schema.name: version_label
schema.hint: Human-readable label (e.g., 'v2.1'). Write-once.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: draft | published | deprecated. Forward transitions only.

schema.name: master_template_file_id
schema.hint: Workato FileStorage ID for the master template file. Set at publish.

schema.name: manifest_id
schema.hint: FK → home base Manifests.id. Ties version to its build artifact. Immutable.

schema.name: published_at
schema.hint: Write-once. Set when status transitions to 'published'.

schema.name: validation_summary
schema.hint: Version-level validation notes. LONG-TEXT capacity needed.

tables.name: CFG_Field
tables.purpose: Defines a single column in the supplier upload template. Scoped to a template version.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Immutable.

schema.name: field_name
schema.hint: Column name in the upload template. Immutable within a version.

schema.name: description
schema.hint: Human-readable field description.

schema.name: data_type
schema.hint: Expected type: string | integer | date | decimal | boolean.

schema.name: required
schema.hint: Whether the field must have a value.

schema.name: must_be_empty
schema.hint: Inverse constraint — field must be blank.

schema.name: column_unique
schema.hint: Whether values must be unique across all rows.

schema.name: data_cleaning_flags
schema.hint: Serialized cleaning directives (e.g., 'trim,uppercase').

schema.name: position
schema.hint: Column display/processing order.

schema.name: lookup_name
schema.hint: Soft FK → CFG_Lookup.lookup_name (scoped by shared template_version_id).

tables.name: CFG_Rule
tables.purpose: Defines a validation rule applied to a field. Evaluated during upload validation (R-002).

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: field_id
schema.hint: FK → CFG_Field.id. The field this rule validates. Immutable.

schema.name: rule_type
schema.hint: Validation type: regex | range | conditional_required | cross_field | etc.

schema.name: condition_field
schema.hint: DEPRECATED. Name-based reference to conditional trigger field. Use condition_field_id instead.

schema.name: condition_field_id
schema.hint: FK → CFG_Field.id. ID-based replacement for condition_field. Preferred.

schema.name: condition_operator
schema.hint: Operator: equals | not_empty | greater_than | etc.

schema.name: condition_value
schema.hint: Operand for the condition.

schema.name: parameter_1
schema.hint: Rule-type-specific parameter (e.g., regex pattern, min value).

schema.name: parameter_2
schema.hint: Rule-type-specific parameter (e.g., max value).

schema.name: error_message
schema.hint: Human-readable error shown to supplier on failure.

schema.name: strict_enforcement
schema.hint: If false, violation is a warning, not a rejection.

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Required. Every rule must be version-scoped.

tables.name: CFG_Lookup
tables.purpose: Defines valid values for a lookup-type field. Referenced by CFG_Field.lookup_name.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Immutable.

schema.name: lookup_name
schema.hint: Logical group name. Joined from CFG_Field.lookup_name. Immutable within a version.

schema.name: valid_values
schema.hint: Pipe-delimited list of acceptable values (e.g., 'value1|value2|value3').

tables.name: CFG_ErrorTranslation
tables.purpose: Maps internal error codes to human-readable messages for supplier-facing output.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Immutable.

schema.name: error_code
schema.hint: Application-defined error code.

schema.name: human_readable_message
schema.hint: Supplier-facing error text.

tables.name: WFA_SupplierRequest
tables.purpose: A data collection request sent to a specific supplier. Binds supplier to a frozen template version.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-008 (bootstrap).

schema.name: assigned_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. IMMUTABLE. Frozen at creation. Never updated.

schema.name: correlation_id
schema.hint: FK → home base Requests.correlation_id. Immutable.

schema.name: supplier_name
schema.hint: Immutable.

schema.name: contact_email
schema.hint: Supplier contact. May be updated if contact changes.

schema.name: assignee_email
schema.hint: Analyst who owns this request. Immutable.

schema.name: has_seeded_data
schema.hint: Whether seed data was provided at request creation.

schema.name: seeded_data_file_id
schema.hint: FileStorage ID for pre-populated data file.

schema.name: seeded_template_file_id
schema.hint: FileStorage ID for the seeded template sent to supplier.

schema.name: file_upload
schema.hint: FileStorage ID of the most recent supplier upload. Overwritten on each submission.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: pending | sent | in_progress | submitted | validated | accepted | rejected.

schema.name: last_updated_at
schema.hint: Timestamp of last status or field change.

tables.name: RUN_Upload
tables.purpose: Records a single file submission from a supplier against a request.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-007a.

schema.name: supplier_request_id
schema.hint: FK → WFA_SupplierRequest.id. Immutable.

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Frozen at creation. Copied from WFA_SupplierRequest.assigned_version_id.

schema.name: submitted_file_id
schema.hint: FileStorage ID of the raw uploaded file. Immutable.

schema.name: extracted_file_version_id
schema.hint: FileStorage ID after extraction/normalization. Written by R-002.

schema.name: valid_payload
schema.hint: Validated row data (JSON). LONG-TEXT capacity needed — monitor for truncation.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: received | extracting | validating | validated | failed.

schema.name: submitted_at
schema.hint: Submission timestamp. Immutable.

tables.name: RUN_ValidationResult
tables.purpose: Summary outcome of a validation pass against a single upload.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID). Generated by R-006.

schema.name: upload_id
schema.hint: FK → RUN_Upload.id. Immutable.

schema.name: template_version_id
schema.hint: FK → VER_TemplateVersion.id. Copied from RUN_Upload.template_version_id. Direct traceability.

schema.name: status
schema.hint: Values: running | passed | failed | error.

schema.name: valid_rows
schema.hint: Count of passing rows. Write-once after validation completes.

schema.name: invalid_rows
schema.hint: Count of failing rows. Write-once after validation completes.

schema.name: completed_at
schema.hint: Validation completion timestamp. Write-once.

tables.name: RUN_FieldError
tables.purpose: Granular record of a single field-level validation failure.

schema.name: id
schema.hint: Business PK (UUID).

schema.name: validation_result_id
schema.hint: FK → RUN_ValidationResult.id. Immutable.

schema.name: field_id
schema.hint: FK → CFG_Field.id. Anchors error to a version via CFG_Field.template_version_id.

schema.name: row_number
schema.hint: Source row index in the submitted file.

schema.name: submitted_value
schema.hint: The value that failed. May be null for required-field violations.

schema.name: error_message
schema.hint: Human-readable error. Source: CFG_Rule.error_message or CFG_ErrorTranslation.

deferred_relations._comment: Pass 2: Add relation-type display columns after all tables exist. These are Workato UI helpers only — not real FK constraints. The recipe resolves table_id and field_id from the Pass 1 results map.
